title: Multi-Agent SEO Analyzer
oneLiner: Six specialized LLM agents that analyze a website in parallel and auto-generate an audit report.
objective: Build an AI-powered multi-agent SEO analysis system using the Google Agent Development Kit, with six specialized agents for comprehensive website evaluation and automated report generation.
achievements: Developed 6 specialized LLM agents - Security, On-Page SEO, Content, Performance, Indexability, and Report Generator.
Implemented parallel agent execution with asyncio orchestration, cutting total analysis time.
Created 11 custom SEO tools for live HTTP requests, HTML parsing, and metrics collection.
Built observability with structured logging, tracing spans, and metrics for monitoring and debugging agents.
